capabilities: View all footprint notes on one map with distinct draft markers
Create and edit footprints through a dedicated form instead of hand-editing frontmatter
Import, reorder, caption, hide, and preview multiple photos per footprint
Read GPS coordinates and capture times from photo EXIF metadata
Search places, reverse-geocode coordinates, and store structured address fields
extras: The plugin interface is currently available only in Simplified Chinese. The README says it is not yet in the community plugin directory (manual installation from GitHub releases is described). It makes direct network requests to OpenStreetMap tile servers and Nominatim, and the README links their usage policies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record travel locations on a map or manage photo attachments and location metadata without hand-editing frontmatter.

relations.evidence: Map tiles are loaded from the configured tile server. The default is OpenStreetMap's standard tile service.
Place search and reverse geocoding use the public Nominatim service at nominatim.openstreetmap.org.

summary: Travel footprint manager that creates and edits notes with an interactive map, photos, and structured frontmatter metadata.
